sonnet.problem: Choice card 9 asks about Acts 8:31, the official's reply, before any earlier card has told that verse. Card 8 tells only verse 30. Story card 10 then tells verse 31 afterward, so it repeats the answer to the question just asked. That jumps ahead of the passage and reverses the setup-then-question order. Card 10 should come before card 9, or card 9 should be dropped.
sonnet.rule: Cards follow the passage in order. A choice card can look back at a verse an earlier card in the same stop told, but never jumps ahead.
